import type { Tool } from "@om-code/tools";

// AC-16.1 positive control: a complete tool compiles clean. If the negative
// control ever passes for the wrong reason (e.g. tsc silently checking
// nothing), this file's absence of diagnostics is what proves the run is
// real — the assertion below requires diagnostics to name the other file.
export const whole: Tool = {
  descriptor: () => ({
    name: "read",
    version: "0.1.0",
    description: "complete",
    risk_class: "read",
    parameters: {},
  }),
  plan: async () => ({ risk_class: "read" }),
  execute: async function* () {
    yield {
      type: "end",
      result: { status: "ok", preview: "", bytes: 0, truncated: false },
    };
  },
};
